observation.layout: gyro(3), gravity_in_base(3), joint_pos_rel(29), joint_vel(29), previous_action(29), ball_rel_history(3x[pos(3),vel(3)]), task_cues(4)
observation.source: IMU + joint encoders + head-camera ball tracker (vision.py) + cue bookkeeping (policy.DribbleTracker)

action.semantics: joint position targets = stance_targets + action * ACTION_SCALE (policy.py), Unitree joint order. The ONNX graph clips the ball readings to the trained range, clamps each target to the joint range, limits its change per step to 9 rad/s x 20 ms, and keeps the first command within 0.024 rad of the measured pose.
action.stance_targets: assets/stance.json = the stance keyframes of assets/g1_dribble_scene.xml (start pose = default targets; obs[114] = +1 left foot forward, -1 right)

joint_profile: assets/arena_g1_profile.json (HIM Arena g1_type5 template: PD gains, torque, speed, range limits; screening limits)
